<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview


ROCm follow-up to [#61978](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/61978), which adds day-0 support for Reflection's [Beam 1.0](https://huggingface.co/reflection/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B) and its [DFlash2 drafter](https://huggingface.co/reflection/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B-DFlash2).


EDIT: Since #61978 has been split into smaller PRs (https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/62042, https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/62052, and https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/62074), I've updated against main and now the PR diff isn't swamped by the changes from #61978.

This PR adds AMD-owned implementations under `vllm/models/beam/amd/` for both `BeamForCausalLM` and `DFlash2BeamDraftModel`. The NVIDIA implementation from #61978 is unchanged in the relative diff. Shared package dispatch selects the AMD classes on ROCm and the NVIDIA classes elsewhere.

## Claims

- Beam 1.0 BF16 loads and serves on 8x MI350X with TP8 and expert parallelism through the AMD model path.
- Beam's required FP32 activation, normalization, Q/K preprocessing, attention-output gate, and logit-softcap arithmetic is retained in AMD-local Triton kernels.
- The AMD target uses standard vLLM ROCm attention and KV-cache updates, linear layers, finalized MoE output, and RCCL collectives rather than NVIDIA direct-cache, CuTe/FlashInfer, or MNNVL fast paths.
- The AMD DFlash2 implementation loads the released 1.93B drafter, generates successfully, and delegates cache writes and cache-format handling to the selected ROCm attention backend.
- The change adds no HIP/C++ kernels and does not modify the scheduler, KV-cache manager, model runner, attention backends, or NVIDIA Beam implementation.

### Serving commands

Target only:

```bash
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 vllm serve reflection/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B \
  --dtype bfloat16 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 8 \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --max-model-len 16384 \
  --max-num-seqs 16 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 131072 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 \
  --attention-backend ROCM_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN \
  --moe-backend triton \
  --reasoning-parser beam \
  --tool-call-parser beam \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice
```

With DFlash2:

```bash
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 vllm serve reflection/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B \
  --dtype bfloat16 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 8 \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --max-model-len 16384 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 \
  --attention-backend ROCM_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN \
  --moe-backend triton \
  --speculative-config '{
    "method": "dflash",
    "model": "reflection/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B-DFlash2",
    "num_speculative_tokens": 8
  }'
```

## Validation

**Setup:** 8x AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950), ROCm 10.1, PyTorch 2.13, TP8 with expert parallelism, Beam 1.0 BF16 and the BF16 DFlash2 drafter.

| Check | Target only | DFlash2 |
|---|---:|---:|
| Ruff checks and formatting | Passed | Passed |
| Current-source ROCm build | Passed | Passed |
| Full 501B checkpoint and drafter load | Passed | Passed |
| GSM8K, 1,319 questions, strict extraction | 1,202/1,319 (91.13% ± 0.78%) | 1,200/1,319 (90.98% ± 0.79%) |
| GSM8K, 1,319 questions, flexible extraction | 1,212/1,319 (91.89% ± 0.75%) | 1,212/1,319 (91.89% ± 0.75%) |

The GSM8K used 5-shot chat, greedy decoding, `max_gen_toks=1024`, TP8, and expert parallelism.

<details>
<summary>Reproduction commands</summary>

```bash
lm_eval \
  --model vllm \
  --model_args pretrained=/path/to/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B,tensor_parallel_size=8,dtype=bfloat16,max_model_len=16384,gpu_memory_utilization=0.85,enable_expert_parallel=True \
  --tasks gsm8k \
  --num_fewshot 5 \
  --batch_size auto \
  --apply_chat_template \
  --gen_kwargs max_gen_toks=1024
```

The lm-eval vLLM wrapper also accepts the top-level speculative aliases:

```text
spec_method=dflash,spec_model=/path/to/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B-DFlash2,spec_tokens=8
```

```bash
vllm bench serve \
  --backend vllm \
  --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8000 \
  --model beam \
  --tokenizer /path/to/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B \
  --dataset-name random \
  --num-prompts 10 \
  --random-input-len 8192 \
  --random-output-len 10 \
  --max-concurrency 10 \
  --request-rate inf \
  --ignore-eos \
  --temperature 0 \
  --seed 42
```

</details>

### Short concurrency sweep
On NVIDIA SPEED-Bench `throughput_8k` / `low_entropy`, with a fixed 1,024-token output, greedy decoding, 16 warmup requests per point, and `10 * concurrency` measured requests:

| Concurrency | Prompts | Target tok/s | DFlash2 tok/s | Speedup | Target TTFT | DFlash2 TTFT | Acceptance length |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 10 | 117.40 | 168.47 | 1.44x | 234.66 ms | 241.48 ms | 3.41 |
| 4 | 40 | 331.88 | 443.00 | 1.33x | 657.87 ms | 297.50 ms | 3.51 |
| 8 | 80 | 492.26 | 769.78 | 1.56x | 634.83 ms | 240.43 ms | 3.63 |
| 16 | 160 | 803.81 | 1,263.22 | 1.57x | 788.46 ms | 265.18 ms | 3.57 |

All 580 measured requests across both modes succeeded. DFlash2 token acceptance ranged from 30.13% to 32.83%. These are single runs without variability estimates.

<details>
<summary>SPEED-Bench run configuration</summary>

Both servers used the same target configuration:

```bash
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 vllm serve /path/to/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B \
  --dtype bfloat16 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 8 \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --max-model-len 16384 \
  --max-num-seqs 16 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 131072 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 \
  --attention-backend ROCM_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN \
  --moe-backend triton \
  --served-model-name beam \
  --disable-log-requests
```

The DFlash2 server added:

```bash
--speculative-config '{
  "method": "dflash",
  "model": "/path/to/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B-DFlash2",
  "num_speculative_tokens": 8
}'
```

Each server was reused across all four concurrency points. `vllm bench serve` issued its initial probe and 16 warmup requests before the measured requests at each point:

```bash
for concurrency in 1 4 8 16; do
  num_prompts=$((10 * concurrency))
  vllm bench serve \
    --backend vllm \
    --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8000 \
    --model beam \
    --tokenizer /path/to/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B \
    --dataset-name speed_bench \
    --dataset-path /path/to/prepared/speed-bench \
    --speed-bench-dataset-subset throughput_8k \
    --speed-bench-category low_entropy \
    --speed-bench-output-len 1024 \
    --num-prompts "${num_prompts}" \
    --num-warmups 16 \
    --max-concurrency "${concurrency}" \
    --request-rate inf \
    --ignore-eos \
    --temperature 0 \
    --seed 42
done
```

</details>

### Remaining validation

- [ ] Accuracy benchmarks (with and without dflash2)
  - [X] GSM8k 
  - [ ] GPQA-diamond
  - [ ] AIME2025
- [X] Performance baseline using NVIDIA [speedbench](https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/SPEED-Bench) 8k with low entropy and 1k fixed OSL
- [ ] Same checks for gfx942

## Details

- **Vendor ownership:** All ROCm target and DFlash2 implementation code lives under `vllm/models/beam/amd/`. The relative diff does not modify `vllm/models/beam/nvidia/`.
- **Platform dispatch:** `vllm.models.beam` exports AMD target and draft classes on ROCm and NVIDIA classes on other platforms.
- **Target execution:** AMD attention uses ordinary backend-owned K/V cache updates. AMD projections use standard vLLM linear layers, MoE returns finalized output normally, and distributed reductions use standard RCCL paths.
- **DFlash2 cache handling:** AMD-local Triton computes context K normalization and RoPE. Cache layout, slot scattering, optional shuffling, and quantization are delegated to each ROCm attention backend's native cache-update API rather than hard-coded pointer arithmetic.
- **Numerics:** AMD-local Triton kernels retain Beam's required FP32 operations and intermediate BF16 rounding boundaries.
- **HIP launch compatibility:** AMD kernels omit CUDA-only Triton launch options such as `enable_reflect_ftz` and `launch_pdl`.
- **Footprint:** 1,968 additions and 2 deletions across 12 Beam model files; no core execution or NVIDIA implementation changes.

AI assistance was used. The submitter should review every changed line and this description before converting the PR from draft.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+from vllm.triton_utils import tldevice as libdevice
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["size"])
+def _silu_mul_kernel(X, Y, size, width: tl.constexpr, BLOCK: tl.constexpr):
+    i = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    src = i // width * (2 * width) + i % width
+    gate = tl.load(X + src, i < size, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+    up = tl.load(X + src + width, i < size, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+    act = tl.div_rn(gate, 1.0 + libdevice.exp(-gate))
+    tl.store(Y + i, act * up, i < size)
+
+
+def beam_silu_mul(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Compute SiLU and multiplication in FP32, rounding only the product."""
+    width = x.shape[-1] // 2
+    output = torch.empty((*x.shape[:-1], width), dtype=x.dtype, device=x.device)
+    if output.numel():
+        _silu_mul_kernel[(triton.cdiv(output.numel(), 1024),)](
+            x, output, output.numel(), width, 1024, enable_fp_fusion=False
+        )
+    return output
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _softcap_logits_kernel(
+    X,
+    WIDTH: tl.constexpr,
+    STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    CAP: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):

+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["SIZE"])
+def _output_gate_kernel(
+    X,
+    G,
+    B,
+    Y,
+    SIZE,
+    G_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    HEADS: tl.constexpr,
+    DIM: tl.constexpr,
+    FLOOR: tl.constexpr,
+    TEMPERATURE: tl.constexpr,
+    BIAS: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    i = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    dtype = G.dtype.element_ty
+    g_idx = i // (HEADS * DIM) * G_STRIDE + i % (HEADS * DIM)
+    g = tl.load(G + g_idx, i < SIZE, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+    if BIAS:
+        b = tl.load(B + i // DIM % HEADS).to(tl.float32)
+        g = (g + b).to(dtype).to(tl.float32)
+    g = (g / TEMPERATURE).to(dtype).to(tl.float32)
+    sigmoid = (1.0 / (1.0 + tl.exp(-g))).to(dtype).to(tl.float32)
+    multiplier = (sigmoid * (1.0 - FLOOR)).to(dtype).to(tl.float32)
+    multiplier = (multiplier + FLOOR).to(dtype).to(tl.float32)
+    x = tl.load(X + i, i < SIZE, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+    tl.store(Y + i, x * multiplier, i < SIZE)

+    num_heads: int,
+    head_dim: int,

+    output = torch.empty_like(attn_output)

+            attn_output,
+            gate,
+            gate_bias,
+            output,
+            output.numel(),
+            gate.stride(0),
+            num_heads,
+            head_dim,
+            floor,
+            temperature,
+            gate_bias is not None,

+def _qk_norm_rope_kernel(
+    Q,
+    K,
+    QW,
+    KW,
+    POS,
+    CACHE,
+    OQ,
+    OK,
+    M,
+    TOKENS: tl.constexpr,

+    Q_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,

+    Q_WEIGHT: tl.constexpr,
+    K_WEIGHT: tl.constexpr,
+    ROTARY: tl.constexpr,
+    NEOX: tl.constexpr,
+    SSMAX: tl.constexpr,
+    OFFSET: tl.constexpr,
+    LOG_DIVISOR: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    token = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64) * TOKENS + tl.arange(0, TOKENS)
+    head = tl.program_id(1)
+    c = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    mask = (token[:, None] < M) & (c[None, :] < DIM)
+    if head < Q_HEADS:
+        x = tl.load(
+            Q + token[:, None] * Q_STRIDE + head * DIM + c[None, :], mask, 0
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        if BLOCK == 128:
+            squares = (x * x).reshape((TOKENS, 4, 32))
+            total = tl.sum(tl.sum(squares, 2), 1)
+        else:
+            total = tl.sum(x * x, 1)
+        y = x * tl.rsqrt(total / DIM + EPS)[:, None]
+        if Q_WEIGHT:
+            y = y * tl.load(QW + c, c < DIM, 0).to(tl.float32)[None, :]

+    else:
+        h = head - Q_HEADS
+        x = tl.load(K + token[:, None] * K_STRIDE + h * DIM + c[None, :], mask, 0).to(

+        if BLOCK == 128:
+            squares = (x * x).reshape((TOKENS, 4, 32))
+            total = tl.sum(tl.sum(squares, 2), 1)
+        else:
+            total = tl.sum(x * x, 1)
+        y = x * tl.rsqrt(total / DIM + EPS)[:, None]
+        if K_WEIGHT:

+        rope_mask = (token[:, None] < M) & (c[None, :] < ROTARY)

+        sin = tl.load(

+            second[None, :],
+            tl.fma(other, sin, y * cos),

+            p = tl.load(POS + token, token < M, 0).to(tl.float32) + OFFSET

+            elif SSMAX == "root10":
+                scale = libdevice.exp(0.1 * libdevice.log1p(p / 2048.0))
+            else:
+                scale = tl.maximum(
+                    130.0 * libdevice.expm1(0.001 * libdevice.log(p)), 1.0

+def beam_qk_norm_rope(
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    k: torch.Tensor,

+            config.hidden_size, config.intermediate_size, f"{prefix}.mlp"
+        )
+        self.input_layernorm = RMSNorm(config.hidden_size, eps=config.rms_norm_eps)
+        self.post_attention_layernorm = RMSNorm(
+            config.hidden_size, eps=config.rms_norm_eps
+        )
+        draft_config = config.dflash_config
+        assert vllm_config.speculative_config is not None

+            hidden_size=config.hidden_size,
+            taps=int(draft_config["conv_kernel_size"]),
+            group_size=int(draft_config["conv_group_size"]),
+            # Query tokens per request: the bonus token plus the mask tokens.
+            block_size=1 + vllm_config.speculative_config.num_speculative_tokens,

+            **conv_args, prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "mlp_conv")

+        self,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor,
+        next_norm: RMSNorm,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:

+            self.post_attention_layernorm.variance_epsilon,
+            conv.block_size,

+        hidden_states, coefficients = conv.prepare(hidden_states)
+        hidden_states = self.mlp(hidden_states)
+        return conv_residual_norm(
+            hidden_states,
+            coefficients,
+            conv.base_kernel[1],
+            residual,
+            next_norm.weight,
+            next_norm.variance_epsilon,
+            conv.block_size,
+            conv.group_size,
+        )

+class DFlash2BeamCandidateSelector(nn.Module):
+    """Scores each candidate token against every candidate one position back.
+
+    For block position `p`, candidate `c` and predecessor `q`, the score is the
+    candidate's own logit plus `<predecessor[q] * h_p, successor[c]>`, where
+    `h_p` is the drafter's hidden state projected to the codebook rank. The
+    predecessor of the first position is the anchor token.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        vocab_size: int,
+        rank: int,
+        top_k: int,
+        params_dtype: torch.dtype,
+        prefix: str,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.top_k = top_k
+        self.predecessor_codebook = nn.Parameter(
+            torch.empty(vocab_size, rank, dtype=params_dtype), requires_grad=False
+        )
+        self.successor_codebook = nn.Parameter(
+            torch.empty(vocab_size, rank, dtype=params_dtype), requires_grad=False
+        )
+        self.hidden_projection = ReplicatedLinear(
+            hidden_size,
+            rank,
+            bias=False,
+            params_dtype=params_dtype,
+            quant_config=None,
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "hidden_projection"),
+            return_bias=False,
+        )
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        candidate_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        unary_logits: torch.Tensor,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        anchor_token_ids: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Edge scores `[requests, steps, top_k (predecessor), top_k]`."""
+        assert hidden_states.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        return candidate_edges(
+            self.predecessor_codebook,
+            self.successor_codebook,
+            candidate_ids,
+            unary_logits,
+            self.hidden_projection(hidden_states),
+            anchor_token_ids,
+            self.top_k,
+        )
+
+
+class DFlash2BeamModel(nn.Module):
+    hf_to_vllm_mapper = WeightsMapper(
+        orig_to_new_stacked={
+            ".q_proj": (".qkv_proj", "q"),
+            ".k_proj": (".qkv_proj", "k"),
+            ".v_proj": (".qkv_proj", "v"),
+            ".gate_proj": (".gate_up_proj", 0),
+            ".up_proj": (".gate_up_proj", 1),
+        },
+    )
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        start_layer_id: int = 0,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        assert vllm_config.speculative_config is not None
+        config = vllm_config.speculative_config.draft_model_config.hf_config
+        self.config = config
+        draft_config = config.dflash_config
+        params_dtype = vllm_config.model_config.dtype
+        self.input_embedding_scale = float(
+            draft_config.get("input_embedding_scale", 1.0)
+        )
+
+        # Replaced by the target's embedding when the speculator loads the draft.
+        self.embed_tokens = VocabParallelEmbedding(
+            config.vocab_size,
+            config.hidden_size,
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "embed_tokens"),
+        )
+
+        # Numbered after the target's layers so the attention layer names, which
+        # key the KV cache, do not collide with the target's.
+        current_vllm_config = get_current_vllm_config()
+        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
+            [
+                DFlash2BeamDecoderLayer(
+                    current_vllm_config,
+                    config,
+                    layer_idx,
+                    prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, f"layers.{layer_idx + start_layer_id}"),
+                )
+                for layer_idx in range(config.num_hidden_layers)
+            ]
+        )
+
+        target_hidden_size = (
+            getattr(config, "target_hidden_size", None) or config.hidden_size
+        )
+        self.fc = ReplicatedLinear(
+            target_hidden_size * len(draft_config["target_layer_ids"]),
+            config.hidden_size,
+            bias=False,
+            params_dtype=params_dtype,
+            quant_config=None,
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "fc"),
+            return_bias=False,
+        )
+        self.hidden_norm = RMSNorm(config.hidden_size, eps=config.rms_norm_eps)
+        self.norm = RMSNorm(config.hidden_size, eps=config.rms_norm_eps)
+        self.candidate_selector = DFlash2BeamCandidateSelector(
+            hidden_size=config.hidden_size,
+            vocab_size=config.vocab_size,
+            rank=int(draft_config["selector_rank"]),
+            top_k=int(draft_config["selector_top_k"]),
+            params_dtype=params_dtype,
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "candidate_selector"),
+        )
+
+    def embed_input_ids(self, input_ids: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        embeds = self.embed_tokens(input_ids)
+        if self.input_embedding_scale != 1.0:
+            embeds = embeds * self.input_embedding_scale
+        return embeds
+
+    def build_context_kv_weights(self) -> None:
+        """Stack every layer's K/V projection and K-norm weight.
+
+        The context K/V for all layers then comes from one GEMM and one grouped
+        norm. Must run after the weights are loaded, since it copies them.
+        """
+        attns = [layer.self_attn for layer in self.layers]
+        self._context_kv_weight = torch.cat(
+            [attn.qkv_proj.weight[attn.q_size :] for attn in attns]
+        )
+        self._context_k_norm_weight = torch.stack(
+            [attn.k_norm.weight for attn in attns]
+        ).contiguous()
+
+    def precompute_and_store_context_kv(
+        self,
+        context_states: torch.Tensor,
+        context_positions: torch.Tensor,
+        context_slot_mapping: torch.Tensor | list[torch.Tensor | None] | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Project the combined target states to each layer's K/V and cache them.
+
+        The drafter's queries attend to these context keys, which carry the
+        layer's K-norm and RoPE like the queries' own keys. Profiling uses a
+        `None` slot mapping to run the projection without writing the cache.
+        """
+        if not hasattr(self, "_context_kv_weight"):
+            # Dummy weights skip `load_weights`.
+            logger.warning_once(
+                "The Beam DFlash2 context K/V weights were built lazily; this is "
+                "expected only with dummy weights."
+            )
+            self.build_context_kv_weights()
+
+        attn0 = self.layers[0].self_attn
+        num_layers = len(self.layers)
+        num_ctx = context_states.shape[0]
+        num_kv_heads, head_dim = attn0.num_kv_heads, attn0.head_dim
+
+        normed = torch.empty_like(context_states)
+        ops.rms_norm(
+            normed,
+            context_states,
+            self.hidden_norm.weight,
+            self.hidden_norm.variance_epsilon,
+        )
+        kv = F.linear(normed, self._context_kv_weight).view(
+            num_ctx, num_layers, 2, num_kv_heads, head_dim
+        )
+        self._store_context_kv(kv, context_positions, context_slot_mapping)
+
+    def _store_context_kv(
+        self,
+        kv: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        slot_mapping: torch.Tensor | list[torch.Tensor | None] | None,
+    ) -> None:
+        from .dflash2_context_ops import transform_context_kv
+
+        first = self.layers[0].self_attn
+        rotary = first.rotary_emb
+        assert kv.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        assert rotary.rotary_dim == first.head_dim
+        assert rotary.cos_sin_cache.dtype == kv.dtype
+        keys, values = transform_context_kv(
+            kv,
+            self._context_k_norm_weight,
+            positions,
+            rotary.cos_sin_cache,
+            first.k_norm.variance_epsilon,
+            first.v_scale if first.v_scale is not None else 1.0,
+            rotary.is_neox_style,
+        )
+        if slot_mapping is None:
+            return
+
+        per_layer = isinstance(slot_mapping, (list, tuple))
+        if per_layer and len(slot_mapping) != len(self.layers):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "DFlash2 context slot mappings must have one entry per draft layer."
+            )
+        for index, layer in enumerate(self.layers):
+            slots = slot_mapping[index] if per_layer else slot_mapping
+            if slots is None:
+                continue
+            attn = layer.self_attn.attn
+            if not hasattr(attn.impl, "do_kv_cache_update"):
+                raise NotImplementedError(
+                    f"{attn.impl.__class__.__name__} cannot update the KV cache."
+                )
+            attn.impl.do_kv_cache_update(
+                attn,
+                keys[index],
+                values[index],
+                attn.kv_cache,
+                slots,
+            )
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if inputs_embeds is None:
+            inputs_embeds = self.embed_input_ids(input_ids)
+        residual = inputs_embeds
+        hidden_states = self.layers[0].input_layernorm(inputs_embeds)
+        for i, layer in enumerate(self.layers):
+            next_norm = (
+                self.layers[i + 1].input_layernorm
+                if i + 1 < len(self.layers)
+                else self.norm
+            )
+            hidden_states, residual = layer(
+                positions, hidden_states, residual, next_norm
+            )
+        return hidden_states
+
+    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
+        loader = AutoWeightsLoader(self)
+        return loader.load_weights(weights, mapper=self.hf_to_vllm_mapper)
+
+
+class DFlash2BeamForCausalLM(nn.Module):
+    # The checkpoint ships neither, so the speculator always aliases the target's.
+    has_own_embed_tokens = False
+    has_own_lm_head = False
+    # Full vocabulary: draft ids are target ids.
+    draft_id_to_target_id = None
+
+    def __init__(self, *, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = "") -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        assert vllm_config.speculative_config is not None
+        self.config = vllm_config.speculative_config.draft_model_config.hf_config
+        self.model = DFlash2BeamModel(
+            vllm_config=vllm_config,
+            start_layer_id=vllm_config.model_config.get_total_num_hidden_layers(),
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "model"),
+        )
+        self.lm_head = ParallelLMHead(
+            self.config.vocab_size,
+            self.config.hidden_size,
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "lm_head"),
+        )
+        draft_config = self.config.dflash_config
+        softcap = float(draft_config.get("final_logit_softcapping") or 0.0)
+        self.logits_processor = LogitsProcessor(
+            self.config.vocab_size,
+            scale=float(draft_config.get("output_multiplier", 1.0)),
+            soft_cap=softcap if softcap > 0 else None,
+        )
+
+    def embed_input_ids(self, input_ids: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.model.embed_input_ids(input_ids)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.model(input_ids, positions, inputs_embeds)
+
+    def combine_hidden_states(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Project the concatenated target-layer states to the drafter's width."""
+        expected = self.model.fc.input_size
+        if hidden_states.shape[-1] != expected:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"The DFlash2 drafter expects {expected} concatenated target "
+                f"features but received {hidden_states.shape[-1]}; its "
+                "target_layer_ids do not match what the target captures."
+            )
+        return self.model.fc(hidden_states)
+
+    def precompute_and_store_context_kv(
+        self,
+        context_states: torch.Tensor,
+        context_positions: torch.Tensor,
+        context_slot_mapping: torch.Tensor | list[torch.Tensor | None] | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.model.precompute_and_store_context_kv(
+            context_states, context_positions, context_slot_mapping
+        )
+
+    def get_draft_kv_cache_layer_names(self) -> list[str]:
+        return [layer.self_attn.attn.layer_name for layer in self.model.layers]
+
+    def get_draft_attn_causal(self) -> list[bool]:
+        """Per-layer causality, aligned with `get_draft_kv_cache_layer_names`."""
+        return [layer.self_attn.causal for layer in self.model.layers]
+
+    def compute_logits(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+        return self.logits_processor(self.lm_head, hidden_states)
+
+    def compute_candidates(
+        self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """The selector's top-k candidate ids and their logits at each position."""
+        return self.logits_processor.get_top_k_tokens(
+            self.lm_head, hidden_states, self.model.candidate_selector.top_k
+        )
+
+    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
+        loaded = {f"model.{name}" for name in self.model.load_weights(weights)}
+        self.model.build_context_kv_weights()
+        # Aliased to the target's after loading.
+        return loaded | {"model.embed_tokens.weight", "lm_head.weight"}

+import torch
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["ROWS"])
+def _transform_context_kv_kernel(
+    KV,
+    WEIGHT,
+    POSITIONS,
+    ROPE,
+    KEY_OUT,
+    VALUE_OUT,
+    ROWS,
+    LAYERS: tl.constexpr,
+    HEADS: tl.constexpr,
+    DIM: tl.constexpr,
+    EPS: tl.constexpr,
+    VALUE_SCALE: tl.constexpr,
+    NEOX: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64) * 4 + tl.arange(0, 4)
+    layer_head = tl.program_id(1)
+    layer = layer_head // HEADS
+    head = layer_head % HEADS
+    col = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    mask = (row[:, None] < ROWS) & (col[None, :] < DIM)
+    kv_offsets = (
+        row[:, None] * (LAYERS * 2 * HEADS * DIM)
+        + (layer * 2 * HEADS + head) * DIM
+        + col[None, :]
+    )
+    key = tl.load(KV + kv_offsets, mask, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    if BLOCK == 128:
+        squares = (key * key).reshape((4, 4, 32))
+        total = tl.sum(tl.sum(squares, 2), 1)
+    else:
+        total = tl.sum(key * key, 1)
+    weight = tl.load(WEIGHT + layer * DIM + col, col < DIM, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    key = key * tl.rsqrt(total / DIM + EPS)[:, None] * weight[None, :]
+    # Beam rounds K normalization before RoPE.
+    key = key.to(KV.dtype.element_ty).to(tl.float32)
+    half: tl.constexpr = DIM // 2
+    if NEOX:
+        partner = (col + half) % DIM
+        second = col >= half
+        rope_col = col % half
+    else:
+        partner = col ^ 1
+        second = col % 2 != 0
+        rope_col = col // 2
+    other = tl.gather(key, tl.broadcast_to(partner[None, :], (4, BLOCK)), 1)
+    position = tl.load(POSITIONS + row, row < ROWS, 0).to(tl.int64)
+    cosine = tl.load(ROPE + position[:, None] * DIM + rope_col[None, :], mask, 0)
+    sine = tl.load(ROPE + position[:, None] * DIM + half + rope_col[None, :], mask, 0)
+    key = tl.where(
+        second[None, :],
+        tl.fma(other, sine, key * cosine),
+        tl.fma(key, cosine, -other * sine),
+    )
+    out_offsets = (
+        (layer * ROWS + row[:, None]) * (HEADS * DIM) + head * DIM + col[None, :]
+    )
+    value = tl.load(KV + kv_offsets + HEADS * DIM, mask, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    tl.store(KEY_OUT + out_offsets, key, mask)
+    tl.store(VALUE_OUT + out_offsets, value * VALUE_SCALE, mask)
+
+
+def transform_context_kv(
+    kv: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    rope: torch.Tensor,
+    eps: float,
+    value_scale: float,
+    is_neox: bool,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Apply Beam K normalization/RoPE and V scaling without touching caches."""
+    rows, layers, _, heads, dim = kv.shape
+    keys = torch.empty((layers, rows, heads, dim), dtype=kv.dtype, device=kv.device)
+    values = torch.empty_like(keys)
+    if rows:
+        _transform_context_kv_kernel[(triton.cdiv(rows, 4), layers * heads)](
+            kv,
+            weight,
+            positions,
+            rope,
+            keys,
+            values,
+            rows,
+            layers,
+            heads,
+            dim,
+            eps,
+            value_scale,
+            is_neox,
+            triton.next_power_of_2(dim),
+            num_warps=4,
+            enable_fp_fusion=False,
+        )
+    return keys, values

+import torch
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _conv_residual_norm_kernel(
+    X,
+    DELTA,
+    BASE,
+    RESIDUAL,
+    WEIGHT,
+    OUTPUT,
+    X_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    DELTA_ROW_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    DELTA_TAP_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    RESIDUAL_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    WIDTH: tl.constexpr,
+    GROUP: tl.constexpr,
+    TAPS: tl.constexpr,
+    QUERY: tl.constexpr,
+    EPS: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    col = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    mask = col < WIDTH
+    group = col // GROUP
+    coefficient = tl.load(BASE + col, mask, 0).to(tl.float32) + tl.load(
+        DELTA + row * DELTA_ROW_STRIDE + group, mask, 0
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    value = tl.load(X + row * X_STRIDE + col, mask, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    result = coefficient * value
+    for tap in tl.static_range(1, TAPS):
+        valid = mask & (row % QUERY >= tap)
+        coefficient = tl.load(BASE + tap * WIDTH + col, valid, 0).to(
+            tl.float32
+        ) + tl.load(
+            DELTA + row * DELTA_ROW_STRIDE + tap * DELTA_TAP_STRIDE + group,
+            valid,
+            0,
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        value = tl.load(X + (row - tap) * X_STRIDE + col, valid, 0).to(tl.float32)
+        result = tl.fma(coefficient, value, result)
+    result = result.to(X.dtype.element_ty).to(tl.float32)
+    residual = tl.load(RESIDUAL + row * RESIDUAL_STRIDE + col, mask, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    result = (result + residual).to(RESIDUAL.dtype.element_ty).to(tl.float32)
+    tl.store(RESIDUAL + row * RESIDUAL_STRIDE + col, result, mask)
+    variance = tl.sum(result * result, 0) / WIDTH
+    weight = tl.load(WEIGHT + col, mask, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    tl.store(
+        OUTPUT + row * WIDTH + col,
+        result * tl.rsqrt(variance + EPS) * weight,
+        mask,
+    )
+
+
+def conv_residual_norm(
+    hidden: torch.Tensor,
+    coefficients: torch.Tensor,
+    base: torch.Tensor,
+    residual: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    eps: float,
+    query_len: int,
+    group_size: int,
+    *,
+    num_warps: int | None = None,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Finish grouped convolution and update the residual before RMSNorm."""
+    rows, width = hidden.shape
+    if num_warps is None:
+        num_warps = 16 if rows <= 256 else (8 if rows < 4096 else 4)
+    output = torch.empty_like(hidden)
+    if rows:
+        _conv_residual_norm_kernel[(rows,)](
+            hidden,
+            coefficients,
+            base,
+            residual,
+            weight,
+            output,
+            hidden.stride(0),
+            coefficients.stride(0),
+            coefficients.stride(1),
+            residual.stride(0),
+            width,
+            group_size,
+            base.shape[0],
+            query_len,
+            eps,
+            triton.next_power_of_2(width),
+            num_warps=num_warps,
+            enable_fp_fusion=False,
+        )
+    return output, residual

+    UNARY,
+    HIDDEN,
+    ANCHORS,
+    OUTPUT,
+    ANCHOR_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    STEPS: tl.constexpr,
+    TOP_K: tl.constexpr,
+    RANK: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_R: tl.constexpr,

+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton

+
+class RMSNorm(nn.Module):
+    """Parameters for normalization performed directly by the model kernels."""
+
+    def __init__(self, hidden_size: int, has_weight: bool = True) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(hidden_size)) if has_weight else None
+
+    def forward(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        raise RuntimeError("Call the model's fused normalization kernels directly")
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _rms_norm_kernel(
+    X,
+    W,
+    Y,
+    N: tl.constexpr,
+    HEADS: tl.constexpr,
+    STRIDE_TOKEN: tl.constexpr,
+    STRIDE_HEAD: tl.constexpr,
+    EPS: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_WEIGHT: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    idx = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    token = row // HEADS
+    head = row % HEADS
+    x = tl.load(
+        X + token * STRIDE_TOKEN + head * STRIDE_HEAD + idx, idx < N, other=0
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    mean = tl.sum(x * x, 0) / N
+    y = x * tl.rsqrt(mean + EPS)
+    if HAS_WEIGHT:
+        w = tl.load(W + idx, idx < N, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+        y = y * w
+    tl.store(Y + row * N + idx, y, idx < N)
+
+
+def beam_rms_norm(
+    x: torch.Tensor, weight: torch.Tensor | None, eps: float
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Normalize strided token/head rows, rounding only after the affine multiply."""
+    assert x.ndim in (2, 3) and x.stride(-1) == 1
+    n = x.shape[-1]
+    heads = x.shape[1] if x.ndim == 3 else 1
+    out = torch.empty(x.shape, device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
+    if out.numel() == 0:
+        return out
+    _rms_norm_kernel[(x.numel() // n,)](
+        x,
+        weight,
+        out,
+        n,
+        heads,
+        x.stride(0),
+        x.stride(-2) if x.ndim == 3 else n,
+        eps,
+        weight is not None,
+        triton.next_power_of_2(n),
+        num_warps=4 if n <= 1024 else 8,
+        enable_fp_fusion=False,
+    )
+    return out
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _boundary_math(
+    x,
+    r,
+    POST_W,
+    NEXT_W,
+    col,
+    dtype: tl.constexpr,
+    N: tl.constexpr,
+    POST_EPS: tl.constexpr,
+    NEXT_EPS: tl.constexpr,
+    X_SCALE,
+    R_SCALE,
+    POST_NORM: tl.constexpr,
+    POST_WEIGHT: tl.constexpr,
+    NEXT_NORM: tl.constexpr,
+    NEXT_WEIGHT: tl.constexpr,
+    SCALED: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    if POST_NORM:
+        x = x * tl.rsqrt(tl.sum(x * x, 0) / N + POST_EPS)
+        if POST_WEIGHT:
+            w = tl.load(POST_W + col, col < N, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+            x = x * w
+        x = x.to(dtype).to(tl.float32)
+    if SCALED:
+        x = (x * X_SCALE).to(dtype).to(tl.float32)
+        r = (r * R_SCALE).to(dtype).to(tl.float32)
+    h = (x + r).to(dtype)
+    if NEXT_NORM:
+        h_fp32 = tl.where(col < N, h.to(tl.float32), 0)
+        y = h_fp32 * tl.rsqrt(tl.sum(h_fp32 * h_fp32, 0) / N + NEXT_EPS)
+        if NEXT_WEIGHT:
+            w = tl.load(NEXT_W + col, col < N, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+            y = y * w
+    else:
+        y = h
+    return h, y
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _norm_residual_norm_kernel(
+    X,
+    R,
+    POST_W,
+    NEXT_W,
+    H,
+    Y,
+    N: tl.constexpr,
+    X_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    R_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    POST_EPS: tl.constexpr,
+    NEXT_EPS: tl.constexpr,
+    X_SCALE,
+    R_SCALE,
+    POST_NORM: tl.constexpr,
+    POST_WEIGHT: tl.constexpr,
+    NEXT_NORM: tl.constexpr,
+    NEXT_WEIGHT: tl.constexpr,
+    SCALED: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    col = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    dtype = X.dtype.element_ty
+    x = tl.load(X + row * X_STRIDE + col, col < N, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+    r = tl.load(R + row * R_STRIDE + col, col < N, other=0).to(dtype).to(tl.float32)
+    h, y = _boundary_math(
+        x,
+        r,
+        POST_W,
+        NEXT_W,
+        col,
+        dtype,
+        N,
+        POST_EPS,
+        NEXT_EPS,
+        X_SCALE,
+        R_SCALE,
+        POST_NORM,
+        POST_WEIGHT,
+        NEXT_NORM,
+        NEXT_WEIGHT,
+        SCALED,
+    )
+    tl.store(H + row * N + col, h, col < N)
+    if NEXT_NORM:
+        tl.store(Y + row * N + col, y, col < N)
+
+
+def beam_norm_residual_norm(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    residual: torch.Tensor,
+    post_weight: torch.Tensor | None,
+    post_eps: float | None,
+    next_weight: torch.Tensor | None,
+    next_eps: float | None,
+    scales: tuple[float, float] | None,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:
+    """Fuse post-norm, scaled residual add and next pre-norm, keeping each cast."""
+    assert x.ndim == residual.ndim == 2 and x.shape == residual.shape
+    assert x.stride(-1) == residual.stride(-1) == 1
+    hidden = torch.empty(x.shape, device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
+    normalized = torch.empty_like(hidden) if next_eps is not None else None
+    n = x.shape[-1]
+    if hidden.numel():
+        _norm_residual_norm_kernel[(x.shape[0],)](
+            x,
+            residual,
+            post_weight,
+            next_weight,
+            hidden,
+            normalized,
+            n,
+            x.stride(0),
+            residual.stride(0),
+            post_eps or 0.0,
+            next_eps or 0.0,
+            *(scales if scales is not None else (1.0, 1.0)),
+            post_eps is not None,
+            post_weight is not None,
+            next_eps is not None,
+            next_weight is not None,
+            scales is not None,
+            triton.next_power_of_2(n),
+            num_warps=4 if n <= 1024 else 8,
+            enable_fp_fusion=False,
+        )
+    return hidden, normalized

+
+from .activation import beam_silu_mul

+
+class BeamMLP(nn.Module):
+    """Dense SwiGLU MLP for the ``dense`` entries of ``mlp_layer_types``."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        intermediate_size: int,
+        hidden_act: str,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None = None,
+        prefix: str = "",
+        reduce_results: bool = True,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.gate_up_proj = MergedColumnParallelLinear(
+            hidden_size,
+            [intermediate_size] * 2,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.gate_up_proj",
+        )
+        self.down_proj = RowParallelLinear(
+            intermediate_size,
+            hidden_size,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.down_proj",
+            reduce_results=reduce_results,
+        )
+        if hidden_act != "silu":
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Unsupported activation: {hidden_act}. Only silu is supported."
+            )
+
+    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        gate_up, _ = self.gate_up_proj(x)
+        out = beam_silu_mul(gate_up)
+        out, _ = self.down_proj(out)
+        return out
+
+
+class BeamSparseMoeBlock(nn.Module):
+    """Grouped sigmoid ``noaux_tc`` MoE with normal finalized output."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = "", reduce_results: bool = True
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_config
+        parallel_config = vllm_config.parallel_config
+        quant_config = vllm_config.quant_config
+        self.is_sequence_parallel = parallel_config.use_sequence_parallel_moe
+
+        self.gate = GateLinear(
+            config.hidden_size,
+            config.num_experts,
+            bias=False,
+            params_dtype=torch.float32,
+            out_dtype=torch.float32,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.gate",
+        )
+        e_score_correction_bias = nn.Parameter(
+            torch.zeros(config.num_experts, dtype=torch.float32)
+        )
+        self.gate.register_parameter("e_score_correction_bias", e_score_correction_bias)
+
+        self.experts = FusedMoEFactory(
+            reduce_results=reduce_results or self.is_sequence_parallel,
+            is_sequence_parallel=self.is_sequence_parallel,
+            gate=self.gate,
+            num_experts=config.num_experts,
+            top_k=config.num_experts_per_tok,
+            hidden_size=config.hidden_size,
+            intermediate_size=config.moe_intermediate_size,
+            renormalize=config.norm_topk_prob,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            use_grouped_topk=(
+                config.n_group is not None and config.topk_group is not None
+            ),
+            num_expert_group=config.n_group,
+            topk_group=config.topk_group,
+            scoring_func="sigmoid",
+            e_score_correction_bias=e_score_correction_bias,
+            routed_scaling_factor=(
+                config.routed_scaling_factor
+                if config.routed_scaling_factor is not None
+                else 1.0
+            ),
+            apply_routed_scale_to_output=True,
+            router_logits_dtype=self.gate.out_dtype,
+            enable_eplb=parallel_config.enable_eplb,
+            num_redundant_experts=parallel_config.eplb_config.num_redundant_experts,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.experts",
+        )
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        num_tokens = hidden_states.shape[0]
+        if self.is_sequence_parallel:
+            hidden_states = sequence_parallel_chunk(hidden_states)
+        output = self.experts(hidden_states=hidden_states, router_logits=hidden_states)
+        if self.is_sequence_parallel:
+            output = tensor_model_parallel_all_gather(output, 0)[:num_tokens]
+        return output
